subject.title: fix(config): key agentDir collisions by volume case sensitivity

question: Should the component-aware filesystem identity helper become the canonical comparison path for both agentDir collision prevention and trusted safe-bin authorization?
rationale: The agentDir correction is well-supported, but reusing the helper changes an executable trust boundary whose acceptable probe and failure semantics require owner approval.

options.title: Approve the shared helper
options.body: Complete exact-head CI and safe-bin owner review, then land the unified implementation if its unknown-probe behavior remains fail-closed for trust checks.

options.title: Split the security change
options.body: Land the agentDir correction separately and retain the existing safe-bin comparison until its component-aware replacement receives dedicated security proof.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared helper
recommendation.body: Complete exact-head CI and safe-bin owner review, then land the unified implementation if its unknown-probe behavior remains fail-closed for trust checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The safe-bin trust surface and most of its hardening history are concentrated in this person's commits.
